title: Intravenous Glucose Tolerance Test Protocol
author: Kent Lloyd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8i7huhn

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast the mice prior to IVGTT evaluation for a duration determined by investigator preference, not exceeding 18 hours.

steps.title: Obtain Baseline Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a baseline blood sample using one of the three approved sampling methods.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Awake Indwelling Catheter Method: Anesthetize mouse (inhalant or injectable), place in dorsal recumbency, clip and sterile scrub surgical site, create 1-1.5cm incision in jugular furrow to expose vessel (Jugular or Carotid), occlude cranial and caudal ends with non-absorbable suture, insert catheter via small vessel incision, stabilize with non-absorbable suture, test patency with lock solution, tunnel distal end subcutaneously and exteriorize between scapulae on dorsum, secure exit point with suture, and close jugular furrow incision with tissue glue, absorbable suture, or wound clips.

Option 2: Retro-orbital (RO) Blood Sampling: Lightly anesthetize with inhalant anesthesia (or injectable if prolonged anesthesia is needed), apply ophthalmic anesthetic to the sampling eye, and use a micro-hematocrit tube to penetrate the intraorbital capillary plexus to obtain ~100uL of blood.

Option 3: Peripheral Sampling: Gently restrain mouse, puncture peripheral blood vessel (tail, saphenous, or submandibular) with a sterile lancet, and measure blood directly via handheld glucometer or collect droplet with a hematocrit tube.

steps.title: Administer Glucose Bolus
steps.instruction: Administer a 0.25-1g/kg intravenous glucose bolus via the tail vein.

steps.title: Perform Timed Blood Sampling
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples at specific intervals following the glucose injection, starting at the time of administration.

substeps.instruction: Obtain samples at 0 (baseline), 1, 5, 10, 20, 30, and 50 minute time points.
Modify specific time points as per investigator needs.
